summary: Neo soul: 70–95 BPM laid-back drums behind the beat, Rhodes on 9th and 11th chords, warm round bass
body: Drums: hip hop grooves played loose and late (Dilla feel): the snare dragging, the hats uneven.
Harmony: extended chords (maj9, m11, 13ths), ii–V movement, chromatic passing chords.
Sounds: Rhodes and Wurlitzer, warm round bass, soft strings.
Mix: warm, a little tape, nothing harsh.

Apply: pattern/gmd-hiphop-beat-1 on the drums, then pattern/prog-neo-soul-characteristic-2 on the keys four bars later. It leaves tempo and sounds to you: move the tempo toward 70–95 gradually, and swap sounds from the links.
